context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 102 validated all Strava consent/authorization features. Both /strava-clube and /perfil pages show Connect and Disconnect buttons. Clicking Connect shows the consent screen with checkbox, privacy policy, and Connect/Cancel buttons. The checkbox correctly enables/disables the Connect button. Privacy policy expands/collapses correctly. Cancel returns to initial screen. Use admin@runpro.com to bypass AccessGate for testing. Use client-side navigation (window.history.pushState) to navigate to /perfil after login.

Feature 1 - /strava-clube Connect/Discon.details: Both 'Conectar com Strava' (strava-page-connect-btn) and 'Desconectar do Strava' (strava-page-disconnect-btn) buttons visible when not connected
